descriptions.preferred: This cultivar forms a widespreading low dwarf shrub and has distinctly shaped, relatively large bronze green leaves. It arose from a seedling selected in the early 1980s and propagated by John Emery of Raraflora Nursery, Berry, New South Wales, Australia. The attractive leaves emerge a light apple green, becoming a bronze green for the summer. They are carried on olive green petioles and shoots. The unusually large (for a dwarf) five-lobed leaves are deeply divided and borderline between the Palmatum and Matsumurae Groups as defined here. The leaves are 7-8 cm long and wide, with the lobes spread outward so that they are distinctly separated right to the lobe junctions. Each lobe is broadly ovate with a pointed tip and the sides of the lower quarter angled inward. The lobes are 15-25 mm broad in the middle, narrowing to 5-8 mm at the lobe junctions. There are about three pairs of irregular lobules along the lobe margins which themselves are coarsely toothed. 'Berry Dwarf' is a surprisingly strong and busy grower for a dwarf, at least for the first few years. It forms a widespreading, dense, twiggy low bush with a spread of 3 m in 10 years but a height of only 1 m.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种形成开展的低矮侏儒型灌木，叶形鲜明，叶片相对较大，呈铜绿色。它源自 20 世纪 80 年代早期选出的一株实生苗，由澳大利亚新南威尔士州 Berry 的 Raraflora Nursery 的 John Emery 进行繁殖。叶片颇具观赏性，初展为浅苹果绿色，夏季转为铜绿色；叶柄和新梢均为橄榄绿色。对于矮生品种而言，其 5 裂叶异常宽大，分裂较深，按此处分类标准，介于 Palmatum Group 与 Matsumurae Group 之间。叶长宽均为 7–8 厘米，裂片向外平展，使各裂片一直到结合部都明显分开。每个裂片为宽卵形，先端尖，裂片下部四分之一两侧向内收。裂片中部宽 15–25 毫米，到裂片基部结合处缩窄至 5–8 毫米。裂片边缘约有 3 对不规则小裂片，而边缘本身具粗锯齿。‘Berry Dwarf’ 作为矮生品种，在最初几年却有出人意料的较强长势，枝叶繁密。10 年可形成冠幅约 3 米的开展、致密、多枝低矮灌丛，而高度仅约 1 米。
